Name: Florence Revived
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
This came as a request in the forums, and amazingly, I was able to reach the original author (on reddit of all places) to update!

[s]So, here's Florence! This was such a throwback; he hasn't been seen since 1.3! He's snarky and hangs around town mostly just smoking and looking cool. He is NOT dateable, and only attends a few festivals. But he's a nice guy! He just feels kind of out of place in the valley, being a city slicker.[/s]

Enjoy!

*NOTE: As of 1.0.1, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30194]Saloon Second Floor[/url] is now a requirement, as Flo has a proper room now!


[b][u]NEW 2.0 EDITION OF FLORENCE!!![/u][/b]

Flo has gotten a massive overhaul! As of 2.0, he now has a full backstory, 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 heart events, and is fully romanceable! He also has optional seasonal outfits! After his 8-heart event, his schedule will change, as he will acquire 3 part time jobs! Get to know all about Flo's deep dark past and how he came to be in the valley!

WARNING: Flo does swear a bit. Don't add him if this offends you.

Heart event guide:

Intro event:
Exit your farmhouse Day 1

2 hearts:
Go to town between 12pm and 4 pm on a sunny day

4 hearts: 
Go to town between 8 pm and 11 pm

6 hearts:
Go to town between 12 pm and 4 pm on a sunny day

8 hearts:
Go to the beach between 10 am and 3 pm.

After this event, his schedule will change. You will find him manning the register at the Saloon Monday and Wednesday mornings, Robin's on Tuesdays, and Willy's on Saturdays and Sundays. Unless it's raining any of those days.

10 hearts:
Go to the forest between 10 am and 3 pm. Must be dating him

Enjoy!
